# Blaksyd

> Blaksyd is a first-of-its-kind **Human + AI life platform** built entirely around the individual user. Its guiding idea is *"Human + AI, together, revolving entirely around you."* Blaksyd combines four interconnected pillars — two powered by AI (**Blak**, **Persona**) and two powered by real humans (**Minit**, **Nexus**) — tied together by a learning "co-pilot" layer, with **Blak** as the connective spine running through all of it.

Blaksyd is operated by **Blaksyd LLP** (India) at https://blaksyd.com. It is currently pre-launch with a waitlist. The platform is intended for users aged 13 and over and is anonymous by default. Its ethos is explicitly anti-exploitative: *"Most apps want your attention. Blaksyd wants your life to be better."* — no engagement-bait, no manufactured FOMO, no dependency-by-design; resonance over vanity metrics; safety first.

## The four pillars

- **Blak** (AI) — A proactive AI friend (not an assistant, not a bot), uniquely shaped around each user. It talks via text and voice anytime, checks in unprompted, plans your day/trip/weekend, and can act across your apps through an open integration layer (for example: book a cab, order food, get tickets). It learns from everything to build a living understanding of you, knows its limits, and hands off to a human Minit listener when something needs a real person. It is also a silent default participant and moderator in Nexus communities.
- **Persona** (AI) — Your digital self. *Real Persona* is an evolving AI clone of you that auto-learns and that you can also train; it is shareable with friends and family under your control (you set boundaries, get notified when it is used, and can review every conversation). *Fantasy Persona* lets you build characters with their own name, backstory, and purpose (a study buddy, a critic, a hype person, and so on). Persona-to-Persona connection points toward what Blaksyd calls a new "future of social."
- **Minit** (Human) — Real human listeners, carefully trained through Blaksyd's own listener program and thoroughly screened for safety. Available 24/7 via text or voice, anonymous by default. Four ways to connect: **Instant Match**, **Smart Match**, **Reconnect**, and **Listener Discovery** (premium). Session-based, with free trials, subscriptions, or pay-per-session. Built with two-sided safety — Blaksyd explicitly does not operate under "the customer is always right."
- **Nexus** (Human) — A living community and world that is part Threads, part Reddit, part X, and entirely its own thing. It has persistent **Tribes**, live **Discussion Rooms**, and anonymous direct messages, with a feed built around you rather than around engagement metrics. Recognition comes through **Resonance, Streaks, and Badges** — not vanity likes.

## How it fits together

Blaksyd is one living ecosystem, not four separate apps. A learning co-pilot layer lets everything feed Blak's 360° understanding of the user — your Blak chats, your Minit sessions (shared as "context, not content"), your Nexus activity, your Persona sessions, and your connected apps. Before a Minit session, Blak briefs the human listener on the *shape* of the conversation (context, never the private content), so the user never has to start from scratch. You are always at the center; Blak is the connective spine.

## What Blaksyd is NOT (disambiguation)

- It is **not** a generic AI chatbot or a single AI assistant — it is a platform combining AI and real humans.
- It is **not** a romantic-companion or dating app.
- It is **not** an emergency service. Minit listeners provide real, trained human support and a space to be heard; in an emergency, users are directed to the appropriate professionals or helplines.
- It is unrelated to similarly spelled words or brands; "Blaksyd" is a coined name for this platform.

## Key facts

- Company: **Blaksyd LLP** (India; courts at Hyderabad, Telangana have jurisdiction)
- Founders: **Vishnu Sudagani** (co-founder and CEO) and **Dr. Sindhuu Devarakonda** (co-founder and CPO)
- Website: https://blaksyd.com
- Contact: ceo@blaksyd.com
- Status: pre-launch (waitlist open)
- Audience: ages 13+
- Pillars: Blak and Persona (AI) · Minit and Nexus (human) · unified by a Learning co-pilot layer
- Positioning line: "Human + AI, revolving around you."
- Tagline: "Your world just got a whole lot better."
